title: atropa bella-donna var. acuminata
intro: Atropa bella-donna var. acuminata, commonly known as Black Beauty or Daturina bella, is a variety of the deadly nightshade plant (Atropa bella-donna), which is a highly toxic plant native to Europe and Western Asia. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including its use in traditional medicine to treat various conditions such as pain, fever, and inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Atropa bella-donna var. acuminata are attributed to its ability to stimulate the nervous system, induce sedation, and exhibit analgesic and anti-inflammatory properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include tropane alkaloids, specifically scopolamine and hyoscyamine, which are responsible for its therapeutic effects.
